WITH pair_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ab.translink,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as pair_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
trader_type_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    SUM(pair_count) as type_total
  FROM pair_counts
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
pair_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.translink,
    pc.tradekind,
    pc.pair_count,
    ttt.type_total,
    CAST(pc.pair_count AS float) / ttt.type_total as share
  FROM pair_counts pc
  JOIN trader_type_totals ttt ON pc.tradekind = ttt.tradekind
),
trader_type_avg_share AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM pair_shares
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.translink,
    ps.tradekind,
    ps.pair_count,
    ps.share,
    ttas.avg_share
  FROM pair_shares ps
  JOIN trader_type_avg_share ttas ON ps.tradekind = ttas.tradekind
  WHERE ps.share >= ttas.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  kp.tradekind as trader_type,
  AVG(kp.pair_count) as avg_record_count,
  AVG(kp.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(kp.share - kp.avg_share) as avg_excess_over_type_avg
FROM kept_pairs kp
GROUP BY kp.tradekind
ORDER BY kp.tradekind;
